tests.name: collectDependencyAdvisories against a real poetry project with an excluded private dependency that is also a transitive dependency of an exported package: the excluded package is NOT resolved or reported on

reported.evidence: Unchanged from the prior round: /tmp/insrc-live-test-logs/t6-collect-dependency-advisories-live.log, both scenarios re-run and passing after every external-review fix (5 rounds, 14 findings total). Scenario A: privatelib unresolvable anywhere -> pip-audit's install fails outright, recorded as an execution gap. Scenario B: privatelib IS resolvable via a local index -> confirmed directly that pip-audit's real output includes it anyway (identically with/without --no-deps), but collectDependencyAdvisories' own mapping keeps it out of matches/queriedCoordinates, surfacing it only in unresolvedDependencies/unavailableSources via the quarantine fix. This remains the one confirmed, real design-assumption gap in the approved LLD (pip-audit's --no-deps does not prevent transitive resolution as the LLD assumed) -- not an implementation defect in t6, and not addressed by any of the five review rounds, which were all independent accounting/config-resolution bugs. Awaiting the user's decision on how to resolve this open item (follow-up Issue + override-approve, or an LLD amendment) before the Story can complete.
